---
name: performance-review
description: Use when reviewing marketplace database queries, API latency, rendering, images, bundles, search, caching, or Core Web Vitals.
---

Define the user-facing or operational metric first. Establish a baseline, inspect query plans/network/rendering/bundle/image behavior, make the smallest justified improvement, and rerun the measurement. Avoid speculative caching and premature infrastructure.

Quality check: the review includes before/after evidence or explicitly records why measurement is unavailable.
